scripts.bootstrap: pnpm up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @blood-connect/admin typecheck
scripts.boundaries: depcruise packages db --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && depcruise apps/web --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-web.json && depcruise apps/admin --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config tsconfig.depcruise-admin.json
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm boundaries:prove && pnpm test
